notes: L in all effect text = current level of this affinity.
Opposing affinities are mutually exclusive unless a Bridge Affinity is taken.
Primal unlock rule: character must have MND + SPT > total number of Arcane Elemental Affinities known.
Emotional level 2 always follows: Max pool +L², pool regen +L for governing stat pool.
Affinity Styles are separate skills that require an Affinity as a prerequisite — see affinity_styles section.
Bridge Affinities are Tier 2 Emotional Affinities that resolve conflicts between opposing pairs.
Arcane affinities represent schools of magical philosophy rather than primal forces.

emotional.description: Metaphysical alignments tied to moral forces. Channeled by clerics, monks, mystics, zealots. Opposing alignments are mutually exclusive unless a Bridge Affinity is learned.
emotional.tier_structure: Tier 1 = core virtue/vice. Tier 2 = Radiance/Shadow/Balance/Order/Chaos/Creation. Bridge = resolves opposing pair conflict.

chastity.name: Chastity
chastity.theme: Virtue of Survival: clarity, restraint, quality.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Clarity.

3.effect: Gain L MP when hit.

4.effect: Spend L Clarity to reduce next MP cost by L.

5.effect: If you have no Clarity stacks, gain 1 at the start of your turn.

lust.name: Lust
lust.theme: Vice of Survival: passion, desire, pursuit.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Invigorate.

3.effect: Gain L SP on hit.

4.effect: Dealing damage gains 1 Invigorate.

5.effect: At Max Invigorate, next attack costs 0 SP.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Fortify.

3.effect: Damage reduced converts to MP restored.

4.effect: +L Fortify stack limit.

5.effect: While Fortify is active, reduce magic damage taken by L.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Regenerate.

3.effect: Overhealing converts to MP or SP.

4.effect: +L to healing received while Regenerating.

5.effect: Overflow Regen stores up to L bonus stacks.

1.effect: Target ally gains L stacks of Barrier.

3.effect: Reducing damage restores MP.

4.effect: Ally hit within 10 ft — transfer L MP to them.

5.effect: Lose MP instead of HP when hit.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Harden.

3.effect: Reducing damage restores SP.

4.effect: SP beyond Max converts to Temp Shield.

5.effect: Gain L SP when Harden reduces damage.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Hasten.

3.effect: Within 5 ft of an ally, take half their incoming damage.

4.effect: Damage taken on behalf of another is reduced by L.

5.effect: Allies within 5 ft gain +L to healing received.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Empower.

3.effect: Heal for half of damage dealt.

4.effect: +L damage vs enemies that damaged you last turn.

5.effect: At Max Empower, gain +1 AP per round.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Focus or Alert (your choice).

3.effect: On hit, spend Focus stacks to gain L SP.

4.effect: No AP spent during upkeep grants +1 AP next turn.

5.effect: Hitting 3 or more targets in a round restores L SP.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Bolstered.

3.effect: Gain L MP when hit.

4.effect: First action each turn costs -L SP.

5.effect: If no AP is used during a turn, regain +1 AP at round end.

1.effect: Target ally gains L stacks of Inspiration.

3.effect: SP beyond Max converts to HP.

4.effect: Inspired allies gain +L Temp HP.

5.effect: Inspiration stacks can be shared — 1 per ally within 10 ft.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Ambition.

3.effect: MP beyond Max converts to HP.

4.effect: When an enemy has an active buff, gain L MP.

5.effect: On hit, steal 1 beneficial effect from the target.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Flow.

3.effect: If SP cost would go below 0, restore the difference as SP.

4.effect: Evading an effect gains 1 Flow stack.

5.effect: While Flow is active, gain a free reroll on one defense per round.

1.effect: Gain L stacks of Concentration.

3.effect: If MP cost would go below 0, restore the difference as MP.

4.effect: At Max Concentration, gain +R to healing and damage.

5.effect: On attack hit, gain 1 Concentration stack.

1.effect: +L to Radiant healing and damage.

3.effect: Overhealing converts to shield.

4.effect: Shielded allies gain +L to Defense rolls.

5.effect: Radiant overhealing converts to 1 AP per application. This AP is not lost at end of round.

1.effect: +L to Shadow healing and damage.

3.effect: Shadow damage heals self for half.

4.effect: +L vs debuffed enemies.

5.effect: Shadow healing damage ignores shields and barriers.

balance_emotional.name: Balance
balance_emotional.theme: Balance of heavenly and abyssal force.

1.effect: +L Radiant or Shadow heal or damage bonus — choose per use.

3.effect: Radiant or Shadow heal x2, or convert damage to heal.

4.effect: When hit by Radiant or Shadow damage, gain +L AP.

5.effect: Immune to Radiant and Shadow statuses.

1.effect: On hit: apply L stacks of Slow.

3.effect: +L to Initiative and Reactions.

4.effect: Resisting an effect restores L MP.

5.effect: Once per round, stabilize effects on allies or self within 10 ft.

1.effect: On hit: gain L stacks of Haste.

3.effect: Roll an extra d6 for movement or initiative.

4.effect: AoE or random effect grants 1 Haste.

5.effect: First attack each round costs 0 AP.

creation.name: Creation
creation.theme: Sacred interplay of creation and entropy.

1.effect: Buff or Debuff application generates 1 Mirror stack. Hold up to L.

3.effect: Store up to L buffs or debuffs. Reapply later.

4.effect: +L to switching targets or actions.

5.effect: Once per round, reverse any single effect on yourself.

bridge_affinities.description: Tier 2 Emotional Affinities. Resolve conflict between opposing pairs, allowing a character to hold both affinities simultaneously.

levels.1: Hold both Gluttony and Charity without conflict. Gain +L to exploration or research rolls.
levels.2: Gain +L when encountering new cultures, technologies, or magical phenomena.
levels.3: Once per long rest, ask GM a logical question about your situation and receive a useful hint. +L to next action.
levels.4: Improvise tools or solutions in half the normal time. +L to these attempts when driven by curiosity.
levels.5: Once per session, open or access any sealed knowledge. +L to resist consequences of forbidden knowledge.

levels.1: If you would gain 1 mark for lust or chastity gain both instead. Gain +L SP when defending an ally from harm.
levels.2: Allies adjacent gain +L to rolls resisting Fear or Charm.
levels.3: Once per long rest, reroll a failed social action using either Lust or Chastity. Add +L to result.
levels.4: SP healing or buff you apply grants target +L to their next emotional check.
levels.5: All SP healing or morale effects you apply this round are doubled. Targets gain +L to next social or emotional roll.

levels.1: If you would gain 1 mark for greed or temperance gain both instead. Gain +L to resist temptation or material attachment.
levels.2: Gain +L when disengaging from combat or conversation without consequence.
levels.3: Once per long rest, become undetectable by non-divine senses for L rounds if not attacking.
levels.4: No longer require mundane nourishment or comfort. Reduce upkeep costs by L% (minimum 1).
levels.5: Once per session, become immune to emotional influence, psychic damage, or fear for L rounds.

levels.1: If you would gain 1 mark for wrath or forgiveness gain both instead. Gain +L SP when resisting provocation or holding action.
levels.2: When acting with intent after a delay, gain +L to the first action taken.
levels.3: Once per long rest, when an ally falls, gain +L to all rolls for one round and ignore fear penalties.
levels.4: While focused on a single task, gain +L to resist distractions, fear, or pain effects.
levels.5: Cannot be forced to act against your nature. Once per session, spend L SP to auto-succeed on a discipline check.

levels.1: If you would gain 1 mark for sloth or diligence gain both instead. Gain +L SP when choosing reflection over escalation.
levels.2: Gain +L to memory-based rolls, insight from loss, or understanding ancient sorrow.
levels.3: Once per long rest, after doing nothing for a round (except defending), gain +L to all rolls for one round.
levels.4: Immune to demoralization or despair-based effects while focused. Gain +L to resist despair.
levels.5: Once per session, enter a trance. You act last, but all actions gain +L and you may reflect before reacting.

levels.1: If you would gain 1 mark for envy or kindness gain both instead. Gain +L to rolls to observation.
levels.2: When losing to or aiding a rival, gain +L SP and insight into their tactics.
levels.3: Once per long rest, when you achieve a victory, grant +L to an ally's next action if they supported you.
levels.4: Transfer your success to an ally within range once per scene. They gain full effect plus +L.
levels.5: Once per session, declare an NPC or ally a successor to a skill. They gain +L to all actions reflecting your tutelage for the session.

levels.1: Hold both Pride and Humility without conflict. Gain +L to Insight rolls when mediating disputes.
levels.2: When you assist an ally, grant +L to their next action if it furthers fairness or redemption.
levels.3: Once per long rest, declare a binding judgment. Accepted parties gain +L to cooperative actions for one scene.
levels.4: Enemies that exploit the weak suffer –L to social defense rolls against you.
levels.5: Once per scene, treat any failure in a social or judgment roll as mixed success if you accept L SP cost.

primal_elemental.description: Alignment with the natural and alchemical forces of the world. Unlock rule: character must have MND + SPT > total Arcane Elemental Affinities known.
primal_elemental.unlock_rule: MND * SPT > count of Arcane Elemental Affinities known.
primal_elemental.tier_structure: Tier 1 = base elements (Earth, Water, Fire, Air). Tier 2 = combinations and derived elements. Tier 3 = triple-element combinations. Tier 4 = Aether (all four Tier 1 at R4). Void requires four elementals at R5.

1.effect: On Hit: Apply L stacks of Crushed.

2.effect: MPR +L. Resist Earth L. Regain L MP when hit by Earth damage.

3.effect: Earthen defense grants +L Block. Regain L HP when Blocking.

4.effect: Reduce push/pull distance by L ft. +L to saves vs forced movement or knockdown.

5.effect: Ignore L Crushed per round. Earth damage reduced by L. Immune to terrain penalties. Adjacent allies gain +L Block.

1.effect: On Hit: Apply L stacks of Chilled.

2.effect: MPR +L. Resist Water L. Regain L MP when hit by Water damage.

3.effect: -L stacks when receiving Burned. Gain L MP when healing others.

4.effect: No penalty on wet or icy terrain. -L Chilled stacks received. +L vs Grapple and Restrain.

5.effect: Water damage reduced by L. Start of turn: remove 1 Burned or Bleeding. Allies healed by you in 5 ft gain +L MP.

1.effect: On Hit: Apply L stacks of Burned.

2.effect: MPR +L. Resist Fire L. Regain L MP when hit by Fire damage.

3.effect: Burned ignores L resistance. Gain L SP when applying Burned.

4.effect: +L Initiative. -L Chilled stacks received. Gain +L MP when gaining Haste.

5.effect: Fire damage reduced by L. Burned lasts +1 turn. Burned stacks reduce enemy MPR by L.

1.effect: On Hit: Apply L stacks of Weathered.

2.effect: MPR +L. Resist Air L. Regain L MP when hit by Air damage.

3.effect: +L to Jump, Balance, Evasion. Ignore fall damage up to 10×L ft. Free stand from Prone.

4.effect: +5×L ft move speed. Permanent Haste. Haste stacks trigger an additional AP.

5.effect: Resist being moved by L ft. Weathered reduces SP by L. First move each turn costs 0 AP. +L Dodge and Deflect.

blood.name: Blood
blood.theme: All life has water in it.

levels.1: Spend HP for MP at 2:1 ratio. On Hit: apply L stacks of regenerate.
levels.2: +L^2 HP, +L HPR.
levels.3: Immune to Bleeding. On Hit: heal L and apply a Bleeding stack.
levels.4: Bleeding damage from enemies or allies heals you for half, rounded up.
levels.5: Blood Funnel: Heal all allies, including you in 6 spaces for L HP, and apply L Regenerate to them.

fire_tier2.name: fire_tier2
fire_tier2.theme: The heart of the flame beats within you.

levels.1: Burned stacks deal +1 damage.
levels.2: MPR +L. Gain L MP when Burned is applied.
levels.3: Burned reduces healing received by L. On hit: Apply 1 Vulnerable stack.
levels.4: +L Fire resistance. Burned ticks you apply restore L MP.
levels.5: Burned damage on you heals you instead.

earth_tier2.name: earth_tier2
earth_tier2.theme: The strength of the mountain is in your bones.

levels.1: +L defense against Prone, Grappled, or any forced Movement.
levels.2: MPR +L. Regain L MP when Crusted is applied.
levels.3: Crushed also reduces Block and Defense by L.
levels.4: Immune to terrain hazards.
levels.5: Count as 1 size larger for movement and force checks.

air_tier2.name: air_tier2
air_tier2.theme: The swiftness of the wind is in your limbs.

levels.1: +L to Performance.
levels.2: MPR +L. Regain L MP after movement ability.
levels.3: Haste grants +1 Dodge per stack. Apply Off-balance
levels.4: On hits: Apply 1 stack of Off-balance.
levels.5: Immune to fall damage. Can act while airborne.

water_tier2.name: water_tier2
water_tier2.theme: The depth of the ocean is in your soul.

levels.1: Chilled stacks do +1 damage.
levels.2: MPR +L. Regain L MP when Chilled is applied.
levels.3: Chilled reduces healing received by L. On hit: Apply 1 Vulnerable stack.
levels.4: +L Cold resistance. Chilled ticks you apply restore L MP.
levels.5: Chilled damage on you heals you instead.

ice_tier2.name: ice_tier2
ice_tier2.theme: The relentless chill of ice is in your veins.

levels.1: Applying Chilled stacks also applies Slow.
levels.2: MPR +L. Regain L MP when Slow is applied.
levels.3: +L cold resist. 2 AP L MP.Summon an L*5 ft ice wall with 1 HP and Lx10 Barrier stacks.
levels.4: Slowed foes take +L damage from ice effects.
levels.5: 2 AP L MP. Incase yourself in ice, gaining +Lx20 Barrier stacks.

levels.1: 1 AP: Gain L stacks of Focused.
levels.2: +L^2 Max MP. +L MPR.
levels.3: 3 AP 2L MP: -L MPR while sustained. Create an L*10 ft diameter steam cloud with it center within L*20 ft for 3L turns, that obscures vision.
levels.4: Deal L fire damage to enemies in the steam cloud when created. While in the cloud, gain +L to attack rolls and SP regeneration.  2AP L MP: Deal L fire and cold damage. Apply L Burned and Chilled to all characters in the cloud.

levels.1: Slow stacks you apply count double when determining movement penalty.
levels.2: +L MPR. Resist Ice L. Ice damage taken reduces Burned stacks by L.
levels.3: Cannot be knocked Prone on icy terrain. Slow stacks last +1 turn.
levels.4: Adjacent allies gain +L to defense vs Slowed or Immobilized foes.
levels.5: Ignore all movement penalties from snow, frost, chill. Ice damage heals you for L if not a critical hit.

levels.1: When you gain Haste, immediately move 5×L ft as a free action.
levels.2: +L MPR. Resist Lightning L. Regain L SP when struck by Lightning damage.
levels.3: Haste grants an extra +1 AP when triggered.
levels.4: Lightning damage ignores shields and barriers.
levels.5: Haste stacks cannot be removed by enemy effects. Lightning damage you take grants +R MP instead. Move actions cost -1 AP but double SP cost.

levels.1: Burned and Crushed you apply deal +L damage if target has both.
levels.2: +L MPR. Resist Fire and Earth L. Regain HP equal to Fire or Earth damage resisted.
levels.3: When you Block or Deflect, deal Fire damage equal to Crushed stacks on attacker.
levels.4: Crushed and Burned stacks reduce target's Block and Dodge rolls by L.
levels.5: Double Burned and Crushed stacks you apply.

levels.1: On hit: Apply +L Blind if target has Crushed or Weathered stacks.
levels.2: +L MPR. Resist Wind and Earth L. Gain L SP when you dodge or deflect.
levels.3: Enemies within 5×L ft have -L to Perception and Ranged attack rolls.
levels.4: Move through hindering terrain at full speed.
levels.5: While obscured, attacks deal +L damage and enemies take -L to defense against your attacks.

levels.1: Halve Slow and Burned stacks applied to you.
levels.2: +L MPR. Regain L MP on hit of target with Chilled or Slow stacks.
levels.3: +L to attack rolls vs targets with both Chilled and Slow.
levels.4: Ice effects reduce enemy Dodge by L and Speed by L×5 ft.
levels.5: Immune to Chilled and Slow. Targets you Freeze gain Burned ×L when they act.

levels.1: Obscuring effects grant +L Stealth. +L attack while Obscured.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L MP when fog or concealment prevents damage to you or ally.
levels.3: Steam terrain effects heal allies in them for L HP per round.
levels.4: Steam illusions count as +L higher tier for resistance purposes.
levels.5: Always considered in cover. +L Defense when obscured.

levels.1: Burned and Crushed stacks you apply reduce target max HP by L.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L MP when Burned or Crushed enemy is incapacitated.
levels.3: Enemies take +L Fire damage if they end their turn Crushed.
levels.4: Gain +L to Earth and Fire Resistance. Standing in lava grants +L Regen.
levels.5: Your Burned and Crushed stacks are immune to cleansing for 1 round after applied.

levels.1: Burned stacks you apply increase Haste by L instead of lowering it.
levels.2: +L MPR. Regain L MP when target gains both Haste and Burned from your ability.
levels.3: Burned stacks on enemies cause them to lose 1 AP if they attempt movement.
levels.4: Haste grants +L to Initiative and Evasion rolls.
levels.5: Burned stacks applied by Haste-triggered effects deal +L bonus damage.

levels.1: Ignore movement penalties from rough, sandy, or broken terrain.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L MP when enemies miss due to terrain penalties.
levels.3: Crushed and Slow stacks applied within terrain you control gain +1 additional stack.
levels.4: Create Dust terrain in 10×L ft radius once per short rest as a free action.
levels.5: Always count as concealed when standing on natural ground.

levels.1: Walk across shallow water and swim without penalty.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L MP when removing Slow, Crushed, or Encumber from an ally.
levels.3: Water and Earth damage you deal heals you for L HP.
levels.4: Resist movement manipulation while touching water or stone.
levels.5: Immune to being Prone, Grappled, or Restrained when standing on natural terrain.

levels.1: +L to Resistance vs Fire and Earth. Burned and Crushed you receive deal -L damage.
levels.2: +L MPR. Regain L MP when taking Fire or Earth damage.
levels.3: Your Burned and Crushed stacks gain +L duration and reduce enemy movement by 5×L ft.
levels.4: +L to checks resisting terrain-based or environmental damage.
levels.5: Regen L HP per round on natural terrain. Your Fire and Earth effects are not resisted by terrain protections.

levels.1: When you apply Slow or Crushed, also reduce target's Dodge by L.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L MP when successfully resisting forced movement or status effects.
levels.3: Allies within 10×L ft ignore the first Slow or Crushed stack each round.
levels.4: +L to all Awareness and Balance checks.
levels.5: Once per round, when an ally within 10 ft succeeds a Defense roll, you gain L MP and +1 Focus.

levels.1: +L to resist Burned, Encumber, and Slowed.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L HP when an ability affects at least two targets.
levels.3: On AoE spell activation, gain +L Temp HP.
levels.4: +L to Diplomacy and Nature-related skills.
levels.5: Environmental AoE effects persist 1 extra turn. Allies inside heal L per round.

levels.1: Crushed and Burned you apply also reduce MP regeneration by L.
levels.2: +L MPR. Gain L HP when enemies fail movement-based checks.
levels.3: Ignore terrain damage. Move across lava, rockslides, or debris at full speed.
levels.4: Enemies in direct contact with terrain take +L environmental damage each round.
levels.5: Gain Tremor Sense. Burned and Crushed stacks you apply spread to 1 adjacent enemy per round.

1.effect: All stacking effects (Burned, Bleeding, etc.) you apply gain +1 stack on application.

2.effect: +L MPR. Regain L MP per round if you have 3 or more different elemental affinities.

3.effect: AoE abilities gain +L to range or radius.

4.effect: When casting an affinity-based ability, ignore 1 point of its cost for each Tier 1 Affinity you know.

5.effect: Immune to non-critical environmental damage. Stacking effects you apply can no longer be resisted or cleansed by base resistances.

arcane.description: Schools of magical philosophy and technique. Shape spellcasting through disciplined study, experimentation, and ritual rather than primal or emotional resonance.
arcane.unlock_rule: Each arcane affinity known counts toward the MND+SPT > Arcane Elemental total check for primal affinities.

levels.1: Animate Corpse — 6 AP, 3R MP: Animate a medium or two small corpses for 3R turns. Max 3 medium or 6 small active.
levels.2: +R Max MP and MPR. Double summoned corpse duration.
levels.3: Animate Corpse AP cost -3.
levels.4: Increase limits to 1 Large, 2 Medium, or 4 Small per summon.
levels.5: Raise limit to 3 Large, 6 Medium, or 12 Small active at once.

levels.1: Transmute Matter — 6 AP, 3L MP: Transform an object into another of similar mass or size.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. +L to skill checks for altering properties (weight, density, form).
levels.3: May animate objects to perform simple tasks (1 AP actions).
levels.4: Transmuted objects persist 2× as long and resist dispelling.
levels.5: Transmute living matter (plants, non-sapient creatures) with extended rituals.

levels.1: On Elemental Affinity Hit: Restore L MP.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. All Affinity spell ranges increase by 10×L ft.
levels.3: Gain +L to Affinity AoE sizes or cone lengths.
levels.4: Empowered Cast: once per turn, double affinity damage dice.
levels.5: All elemental spells ignore 1 point of Resistance per level in this skill.

levels.1: Create sensory phantasms for up to L×10 minutes (sight, sound, smell).
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. Illusions may mimic physical presence but deal no damage.
levels.3: Illusory Assault: target rolls defense vs false damage or suffers penalty.
levels.4: Create illusions that persist while unattended or across areas.
levels.5: Illusions are semi-autonomous and may mimic up to L commands.

levels.1: Energy Shields gain +L Damage Resistance.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. Gain resistance to dispel or counterspells.
levels.3: Warded Stance: passive shield resists elemental splash effects.
levels.4: Reflexive Ward: once per round, reduce incoming spell damage by L×2.
levels.5: Maintain passive barrier even while unconscious.

levels.1: Summon Object — 6 AP, 3L MP: Conjure a Medium or smaller item for L hours.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. Conjured items may include minor enchantments.
levels.3: Reduce AP cost by -2. Duration doubled.
levels.4: Create large or complex objects (tents, carts, siege tools).
levels.5: Conjured objects function as real and persist up to L days.

levels.1: Astral Eye — 6 AP, 3L MP: Summon a floating sensor for L hours.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. +L to Detect, Insight, and Arcana checks.
levels.3: Eye gains the ability to relay emotional states or magical auras.
levels.4: Precognitive Insight: Reroll 1 failed roll per encounter.
levels.5: Maintain perfect awareness of all targets within line of sight.

levels.1: Ritual Enchant — Spend L hours and 30 MP×L/hour to give +L weapon or armor bonus.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. May enchant up to L items.
levels.3: Half MP cost. Not interrupted unless damaged by a critical hit.
levels.4: May bind enchantments to other characters' gear.
levels.5: May combine two enchantments into one item.

levels.1: 1 AP, 2L MP: Weapon gains one Affinity for 2L turns, applying On Hit triggers.
levels.2: +L Max MP and MPR. May apply L Augments simultaneously.
levels.3: On Hit triggers apply stacks equal to Affinity skill level.
levels.4: Augments last indefinitely but count against enchantment limit.
levels.5: Augmented weapons apply +L to Affinity skill checks.

levels.1: 3 AP, 3L MP: Apply L² Haste stacks in 15×L ft radius.
levels.2: 2 AP, 3L MP: Apply L² Slow stacks to a single target.
levels.3: +L Max MP and MPR. Dodge no longer causes double damage on failure.
levels.4: Echo Step: once per round, repeat one movement-based action.
levels.5: May act during another character's turn once per round at -1 AP cost.

levels.1: +L MPR. When you sleep, gain visions that may reveal hidden truths. +L to resist Illusion and Fear effects.
levels.2: Cast minor illusionary effects during rest or meditation. Regain L MP if unbothered during full rest.
levels.3: +L to resist sleep and unconscious states. Dreams you shape may interact with other dreamers.
levels.4: While unconscious or meditating, send a short telepathic message to a known target. +L to control shared dreamscapes.
levels.5: Project yourself into the Dreamscape once per long rest for L minutes. Actions can influence waking world NPCs (GM discretion).

levels.1: +L MPR. On Hit with Shadow abilities: +L Shadow damage. Shadows controlled within 10×L ft.
levels.2: +L to stealth and darkness-based perception. Regain L MP when attacking from concealment.
levels.3: Create pockets of magical darkness (15 ft radius) obscuring sight for non-umbramancers. +L shadow damage.
levels.4: Shadow may act as independent echo (no damage; can manipulate switches or distract).
levels.5: Enter or exit shadows for teleportation within 10×L ft once per turn. Cannot pass through solid walls.

prerequisite.description: Requires mastery of 5 different Arcane affinities.

1.effect: On hit with Affinity abilities, apply +L Null (prevents regeneration for 1 round).

2.effect: +L MPR. Regain L MP when a status effect ends.

3.effect: Stacking effects you apply do not decay naturally.

4.effect: Ignore line of sight and cover for Affinity effects.

5.effect: Targets killed while a stacking effect is active cannot be resurrected for L rounds.

levels.1: +L MPR. Once per day, teleport self and carried items up to 10×L ft in line of sight.
levels.2: +L to Initiative and Reflex. Teleport a willing ally within 5×L ft to nearby safe square as a reaction.
levels.3: Once per combat, delay a teleport up to L turns, activating as free action later.
levels.4: Teleport no longer triggers opportunity attacks. Regain L MP when teleporting into danger.
levels.5: Once per rest, Mass Teleport up to L allies (100×L ft range). Arrival must be known or visible location.

levels.1: +L MPR. Choose one metamagic trait: Empower, Extend, or Quicken. Apply 1 metamagic per turn for free.
levels.2: Maintain 2 metamagic effects simultaneously. +L to spell effectiveness checks.
levels.3: Regain L MP when a spell with metamagic hits 2+ targets or deals 20+ damage.
levels.4: Reduce MP cost of metamagic by L.
levels.5: Apply all 3 base metamagic traits to one spell once per long rest without cost.

levels.1: +L MPR. Substitute SPT for MND on any magic attack rolls or checks.
levels.2: +L to resist Charm, Fear, and Illusion effects.
levels.3: Communicate telepathically with one creature within 10×L ft.
levels.4: Control the emotions of a target for L rounds with a successful opposed roll.
levels.5: Dominate a target (charm + command effect) for 1 round once per rest.

levels.1: +L MPR. Amplify voice, eyes, or other sensory elements for roleplay or minor illusions.
levels.2: Minor environmental effects gain +L range and intensity.
levels.3: Spend L MP to generate a minor divine or infernal manifestation for up to 1 minute.
levels.4: Disrupt enemy magic with dramatic gestures, imposing -L to their spell success for 1 round.
levels.5: Once per rest, perform a Major Manifestation — a highly cinematic effect tied to your mythic presence (GM determines final impact; must be scene-defining).

levels.1: +L MPR. Your spells may be delayed by 1 round without losing effectiveness.
levels.2: +L to Initiative and Temporal magic rolls. Spells may be queued and auto-triggered under set conditions.
levels.3: Delay an enemy's action by L ticks with a successful opposed MND check.
levels.4: Take 1 additional reaction per round, usable only for time-based effects or parries.
levels.5: Once per rest, rewind your own position to L ticks ago (position, HP, and active conditions only).

levels.1: +L MPR. Carve magical sigils that hold 1 spell for delayed activation.
levels.2: Sigils may affect up to L targets. Triggering range increased to 10×L ft.
levels.3: Embed L sigils into weapons, armor, or surfaces for persistent field effects.
levels.4: Sigils can be triggered remotely or set to automatic conditional logic.
levels.5: Combine two different spells into one sigil, activating simultaneously.

levels.1: +L MPR. Craft temporary runes granting +L to spell rolls or damage of chosen element.
levels.2: Runes grant Resistance L to a chosen energy type while active.
levels.3: Up to L runes active at once. Apply runes as bonus action.
levels.4: Create semi-permanent runic glyphs empowering areas (shrines, battlegrounds, fortifications).
levels.5: Once per rest, inscribe a Master Rune granting +L to all allies' MP regen and damage resistances in 20 ft radius.

levels.1: +L MPR. Bind minor spirits into trinkets or relics, granting +L to 1 skill or resistance.
levels.2: Bound spirits may speak to you. +L to negotiations with ethereal beings.
levels.3: Forcibly bind a hostile spirit for L rounds with an opposed MND roll.
levels.4: Channel a bound spirit to reroll one failed spell check per rest.
levels.5: Host up to L spirits. Spirits grant passive bonuses or unique once-per-day effects (GM defined).

levels.1: +L MPR. In sacred or spiritually aligned locations, regain L MP per round.
levels.2: Attune to ley lines or power centers, detecting their flow and influence.
levels.3: Spend L MP to suppress or enhance emotional energies in 10×L ft zone.
levels.4: Harmonize with a spiritual aura to gain Resistance L to mental effects.
levels.5: Once per rest, enter a trance gaining visions of nearby threats, allies, or spiritual truths.

requirements.description: Access to at least 3 different magical traditions

levels.1: +L MPR. Substitute one component of a spell (verbal, somatic, material) with another.
levels.2: Choose 1 spell from another Arcane Domain and treat it as from your primary Domain.
levels.3: +L to cast hybrid spells using elements from two different Domains.
levels.4: Spend L MP to convert any affinity ability into an Arcane Domain spell temporarily.
levels.5: Once per day, replicate any spell cast within 100 ft in the last L rounds.
